+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import numpy as np

+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

+DATA = ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet"
+
+query = f"""
+    SELECT
+        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INTEGER AS year,
